$comment: Scripted transport for the agent e2e (AICAD_AGENT_TRANSPORT=scripted): 'Make the plate 2 mm thicker' on the t1-nema17-plate template. Offline: no network, no keys. Every run replays this script from the start. Turns are genuine Anthropic stream events generated by @aicad/agent ScriptedTransport; costs are priced from the model profiles.

input.reason: one dimension of the open plate changes

designer.text: The plate is `extrude(outline, { distance: 5 })`. Before changing it I need the direction of the extra material.

questions.question: Which way should the extra 2 mm go?
options: Up (+Z), keep the bottom face on the build plate
questions.default: Up (+Z), keep the bottom face on the build plate

designer.text: Thickening upward only changes the extrude distance: 5 → 7 mm. The holes go through, so nothing else moves.

input.summary: The NEMA 17 plate is now 7 mm thick (was 5 mm). The extra 2 mm goes up, so the bottom face stays on the build plate; the 22 mm pilot and the four M3 holes are unchanged and still go through.
assumptions: thickened upward: bottom face stays at Z = 0
hole sizes unchanged (pilot Ø22, M3 Ø3.4)
